frontier.hypothesis: If func_80078654 is ever re-attempted, the only remaining unexplored surface is a different TU-level or header-level premise, not a body-level respelling: every body-level partition of the twelve buffer accesses is now measured dead.
frontier.mechanism: The forced-decomposition theorem is now fully deductive — the target has exactly three callee-save-resident values; every one of the twelve buffer accesses must be a direct dereference of a pseudo holding arg0's value (a derived pointer emits displacement 0 instead of 0xC/0x14); a pseudo carrying a proper subset either crosses a call (fourth callee-save, s8a) or is call-free and deleted by cse (s9). So reg_n_refs(arg0) = 13 / pri 3979 in every conforming compile, against a walk-pointer ceiling of 8 refs / pri 2448.
frontier.next_probe: Only a premise OUTSIDE the function body could change the reference census — e.g. a corrected declared type for D_800A3610 or for the S78654 field layout that changes how many separate accesses the twelve buffer touches decompose into. That is a header/evidence question, not a codegen-lever question, and it requires evidence of the original object model (which memory/splat-symbol-names-are-not-evidence warns splat's D_ names cannot supply). Do NOT re-grind the body.
